definitions.gloss: pagan; heathen; follower of a different religion
definitions.explanation: A person who follows a religion different from one's own, or who does not belong to the speaker's faith. Often carries a historical or religious-conflict connotation, as in accounts of crusades or missionary work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}ら→彼ら：01802_karera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{異教徒|いきょうと}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧みなされた。
⟦{中世|ちゅうせい}→中世：05524_chuusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{異教徒|いきょうと}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{迫害|はくがい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In the Middle Ages there was persecution of nonbelievers.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{異教徒|いきょうと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改宗|かいしゅう}⟦させよう→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{宣教師|せんきょうし}→宣教師：12382_senkyoushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: The king sent missionaries to try to convert the heathens.

notes:
Refers to a follower of a religion other than one's own, especially in historical or religious-conflict contexts. Composed of ⟦{異|い}→異：01925_i⟧ (different) + {教|きょう} (religion, teaching) + {徒|と} (follower).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異教徒|いきょうと}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧みなす: to regard as a pagan
- {異教徒|いきょうと}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{迫害|はくがい}: persecution of nonbelievers
- {異教徒|いきょうと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改宗|かいしゅう}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧: to convert the heathens

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{異教|いきょう}→異教：29855_ikyou⟧: paganism; a different religion — the belief system, not the person
- {無神論者|むしんろんしゃ}: atheist — one who denies the existence of any god, not merely a different faith
